title: Banner, backdrops & flags — Flag artwork
slide_intent: Show how to arrange a two-sided flag so the symbol occupies the same position through the fabric and the words remain readable on each side.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can keep its mark aligned in a moving medium while identifying the local program from either direction.
demonstration: Front and reverse flags face each other across a pole. The top pair uses a layered curve and the lower pair uses flat color.
practical_value: Start with the illustrated 2:3 flag and reverse the order of symbol and words for the reverse face. Check both faces together.

content_islands.name: Flag artwork notes
content_islands.spec: Place instructions about lockup reversal, program naming and flag proportions in the left column.

content_islands.name: Layered flag faces
content_islands.spec: Place reverse at left and front at right. Put the pole between the flags and mirror the position of the symbol while keeping the words upright.

content_islands.name: Flat-color flag faces
content_islands.spec: Repeat the two-sided arrangement below the dotted divider using a single red curve. Label every face.
